description: Minimal documentation acceptable for sandbox environments

action.recommendation: Sandbox environments require only a brief README explaining purpose and setup. Extensive documentation is not expected at this stage — focus on exploration and learning.

rationale: Sandbox environments are experimental; imposing documentation overhead reduces exploration velocity.

description: Testing is optional in sandbox environments

action.recommendation: Formal testing is not required for sandbox projects. Consider adding basic smoke tests if the sandbox code will graduate to a PoC or MVP stage.

rationale: Sandboxes are throwaway code; enforcing testing adds friction without business value.

description: README required for Proof of Concept projects

action.recommendation: Create a README.md documenting the PoC purpose, assumptions, limitations, and how to run it. This helps stakeholders evaluate the PoC and supports handover if it progresses to MVP.

rationale: PoCs are reviewed by stakeholders and may be handed over. A README is the minimum documentation for evaluation.

description: Basic unit tests recommended for PoC projects

action.recommendation: Add basic unit tests for critical PoC logic. This validates your approach and makes the PoC easier to evolve into an MVP. Aim for coverage of core decision paths.

rationale: Basic tests in a PoC validate the approach and reduce rework if the PoC is promoted.

action.recommendation: Maintain a CHANGELOG.md following Keep a Changelog format. Document what changes, why, and how to migrate. This supports user communication and release management.

rationale: MVPs have real users. A CHANGELOG communicates changes and builds trust.

description: CI pipeline required for MVP stage

action.recommendation: Set up a CI pipeline (GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, or similar) for your MVP. At minimum: run tests on every PR, lint code, and block merges on test failures. This prevents regressions as the team grows.

rationale: MVPs grow into products. A CI pipeline established early prevents quality degradation under feature pressure.

description: Integration tests required for beta stage

action.recommendation: Add integration tests covering key user journeys before beta launch. Test API contracts, database interactions, and external service integrations. Aim for 70%+ coverage of integration points.

rationale: Beta users encounter real integration failures. Integration tests catch issues before they reach users.

description: Staging environment required for beta deployments

action.recommendation: Establish a staging environment that mirrors production for beta testing. Deploy to staging before production, run integration tests against staging, and validate releases with beta users in the staging environment.

rationale: A staging environment catches environment-specific issues before they impact production beta users.

description: SRE runbooks required for production systems

action.recommendation: Create SRE runbooks for all production services. Each runbook must cover: service overview, dependencies, deployment procedure, rollback procedure, common failure modes, and on-call escalation contacts. Store in a searchable, versioned location.

rationale: Production incidents require immediate, documented response procedures. Missing runbooks extend MTTR and increase blast radius.

action.recommendation: Implement comprehensive monitoring for production services. Define SLOs (availability, latency, error rate), set up alerting on SLO breaches, create dashboards for key metrics, and ensure on-call engineers receive actionable alerts with runbook links.

rationale: Production systems must be observable. Without monitoring and alerting, outages are discovered by users rather than operators.

description: Disaster recovery plan required for production

action.recommendation: Document and test a Disaster Recovery plan for production systems. Define RTO and RPO targets, document recovery procedures, automate backups with verified restore tests, and conduct DR exercises at least annually.

rationale: Production systems must survive failures. Untested DR plans fail when needed most.

description: Document maintenance mode constraints for legacy systems

action.recommendation: Document the system's maintenance-mode status. Record: known issues not being fixed, deprecated features timeline, migration path for users, and the scheduled end-of-life date. Minimise new dependencies and changes.

rationale: Legacy systems in sunset need clear documentation to manage stakeholder expectations and guide migration.
